'''Vo'ren Faalo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Battlemaster/Legends|Battlemaster]] sometime before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Vo'ren Faalo was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Appointed as the [[Battlemaster/Legends|battlemaster]] of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Faalo was regarded as one of the most proficient [[Jedi instructor|instructors]] of his time.<ref name="JATM" /> During his time as battlemaster, Faalo authored the ''[[Book of Practical Lightsaber Technique]]''. In his book, he detailed a series of [[Faalo's cadences|training cadences]] in which a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attempted to manipulate small steel bearings atop candles with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> He also described a [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic lightsaber technique]], which would be later named "[[Faalo's Will]]" after him.<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Faalo's Will}}</ref>

==Legacy==
Long after Faalo's physical [[Death/Legends|death]], his teachings lived on in the Jedi Order for several centuries. Despite the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Faalo's teachings were remembered by survivors such as an [[Unidentified Jedi (Faalo's Will)|Unidentified Jedi]] and [[Adalric Cessius Brandl]] who passed the cadences on to his student [[Fable Astin/Legends|Fable Astin]].<ref name="Uhl Eharl Khoehng short story">{{JournalCite|8|Uhl Eharl Khoehng (short story)}}</ref> Additionally, former Jedi-turned-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[ASP-19 battle droid/Legends|ASP-19]] [[Training droid/Legends|training droids]] were rumored to be programmed with Faalo's personal lightsaber training techniques, taken from a Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].<ref name="SotES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
